name: Maxio Technology (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd.
summary: Maxio Technology (Hangzhou) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, marketing, and sale of data management, general-purpose IP, and SOC chips in China. The company is involved in production of computer software products; import and export of self-produced products, goods, or technology; and providing technology development and technical services. It also offers SSD controller, embedded storage control, and network communication chips, as well as SATA and PCIe SSD, and embedded memory solutions.
